report_topic: Performance Audit on Outcomes in Surface Irrigation
observations_summary: None of the six projects were completed on time and all experienced significant cost overruns. Irrigation potential targets were not achieved, and utilization was inadequate, leading to shortfalls in irrigation of targeted areas and lower agricultural produce value than estimated. Poor maintenance of canal systems and non-functional Water User Associations further hampered outcomes, with a significant amount of water cess remaining outstanding.
